scenes.title: LIKE
scenes.narration: LIKE matches text against a pattern, powering flexible searches on string columns.

scenes.title: Pattern matching
bullets: Percent sign matches any run of characters
Great for prefix and contains searches
scenes.narration: LIKE compares text to a pattern built from wildcard symbols. The percent sign stands for any sequence of characters, while the underscore matches exactly one. Together they handle prefix, suffix, and contains-style searches with ease.

scenes.title: Searching by pattern
scenes.narration: This query matches any email that ends with the gmail domain. The leading percent sign allows any characters before the at sign. The result lists customers whose email addresses use Gmail.

scenes.title: How a pattern is matched
steps: Compare each value character by character
Keep rows that match the shape
scenes.narration: LIKE interprets the wildcards in your pattern to define a shape for the text. It then compares each value against that shape. Rows whose text fits the pattern are kept in the result.

scenes.text: LIKE brings flexible text search to SQL, but leading wildcards can prevent index use.
scenes.narration: Use LIKE for pattern-based text searches, and be aware that a leading wildcard often forces a full scan instead of an index seek.
